annotations.title: What changed at a company since a date

description:
List what changed at a company since a date, from every official record Fuentio holds for it: status, name, address, legal form, and the source's dated events (BORME acts), each with its source and evidence.
Use it to review a supplier or customer since your last check. Don't use it for the current state: call lookup_company.
Inputs: entity_id (from resolve_company, e.g. 'fu_7K3M9Q2XH4PZ'), since 'YYYY-MM-DD', optional until.
Returns: changes (type, old/new or added/removed, observed_at or effective_date, source, evidence), gaps (days not loaded, sources not checked since), uncertainty.
Limits: 1 unit. A gap is never reported as no change. Read-only.
name: what_changed

outputSchema.description: resolve_company and explain_match (brief 007 P1.7): the service's answer as is.
outputSchema.title: GraphOutput
